UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no kind, or one this enum does not model; the source's own token, when there is one, rides in SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.

RUNWAY.description: A runway, including water runways at seaplane bases.

HELIPAD.description: A helipad or other vertical-operations pad.

BERTH.description: A berth a vessel moors alongside.

LAUNCH_PAD.description: A launch or landing pad at a spaceport.

TFNDesignator.description: One designator the facility answers to in a named coding system.

SCHEME.description:
Coding-system token, verbatim (the system's own name). Never a field
name and never normalized by the publisher.

VALUE.description: The designator within that system, verbatim.

TFNOperatingSurface.description:
One operating surface: the arrival/departure geometry of the facility.
A runway and a berth carry the same shape; fields a domain does not use
are absent (NaN), never zero.

SURFACE_ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier of this surface within the facility.

UNSPECIFIED.description: The source publishes no kind, or one this enum does not model; the source's own token, when there is one, rides in SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.

RUNWAY.description: A runway, including water runways at seaplane bases.

HELIPAD.description: A helipad or other vertical-operations pad.

BERTH.description: A berth a vessel moors alongside.

LAUNCH_PAD.description: A launch or landing pad at a spaceport.

SURFACE_TYPE_CODE.description:
The source's own surface-kind token, verbatim, so a kind outside
tfnSurfaceKind survives a round trip.

DESIGNATOR.description:
Published designator of the surface, verbatim (runway designator,
berth number).

DEPTH_M.description: Available depth of water, metres, for a maritime surface.

SURFACE_MATERIAL.description: Surface material or construction, verbatim as the source states it.

TRUE_BEARING_DEG.description: True bearing of the surface's operating direction, degrees, [0, 360).

THRESHOLD_LATITUDE.description:
Geodetic position of the threshold or reference point of this
surface, decimal degrees on WGS 84.

TFNProvenance.description:
Dataset lineage and redistribution terms for one facility record.

Required on every record: a redistributed facility whose dataset, epoch,
and licence are unstated is not publishable. The standard names no
dataset, provider, or site.

DATASET_ID.description:
Publisher-stable, lowercase identifier for the dataset this facility
was taken from, unique within the publisher's own dataset registry.

DATASET_NAME.description: The dataset's own name, verbatim as its publisher states it.

DATASET_URL.description: Replayable URL of the dataset as published.

DATASET_EPOCH.description:
RFC 3339 UTC fixed-millisecond epoch of the dataset edition this
facility was decoded from.

DATASET_CID.description: Content identifier of the exact dataset artifact, when one exists.

SOURCE_URL.description: Replayable URL identifying the source material within the dataset.

SOURCE_QUERY.description: The exact query, filter, or file selection used.

LICENSE.description:
Redistribution terms verbatim. Unknown terms are never public domain
and never an implied grant.

LICENSE_URL.description: URL of the full licence text as the dataset publishes it.

ATTRIBUTION.description: Attribution text the licence requires a redistributor to display.

SHARE_ALIKE.description: The licence obliges derived works to carry the same terms.

NATIVE_ID.description: The source dataset's own identifier for this facility, verbatim.

NATIVE_MODIFIED.description: RFC 3339 UTC date the source last modified this row, as it states.

ID.description: Publisher-stable identifier for this facility record.

PLACE_ID.description:
`$GNP.ID` of the gazetteer place carrying this facility's name set
and location. Location is joined, never re-published here.

NAME.description:
Operational display name, verbatim, when it differs from the place
name in `$GNP`.

DESIGNATORS.description: Every designator the facility answers to, scheme-tagged.

COUNTRY_CODE.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase, as the source states it.

ELEVATION_M.description:
Field or reference elevation, metres above mean sea level as the
source publishes it. Zero means unpublished, never sea level; a
facility at sea level is distinguished by ELEVATION_PUBLISHED.

MAGNETIC_VARIATION_DEG.description:
Magnetic variation at the facility, degrees, positive east, as the
source publishes it. NaN when unpublished.

OPERATING_SURFACES.description: The operating surfaces of the facility.

MAXIMUM_DRAFT_M.description: Maximum vessel draft the facility accepts, metres.

ANCHORAGE_DEPTH_M.description: Depth of water at the principal anchorage, metres.

HARBOR_TYPE.description: Harbor type token, verbatim as the source publishes it.

SHELTER_AFFORDED.description: Shelter afforded token, verbatim as the source publishes it.
